purpose: New event and near-miss evidence identified after the consolidation sprint. Candidates remain staged until canonical deduplication/admission review.

location.label: Eastern Shore north and/or south of Great Point Clear

candidates.notes: May reports bottom-water DO <2 ppm over 12,955 ha on Aug 5-6, including 8,502 ha <1 ppm, followed by early-morning Jubilees Aug 7 and Aug 8 along the Eastern Shore north and south of Great Point Clear. Preserve spatial ambiguity by date until original field notes/newspaper chronology resolve which shoreline segments were active on each morning.

location.label: Eastern Shore north and south of Great Point Clear; severe effects south of Great Point Clear

candidates.notes: May describes the Aug 8 Jubilee as extensive, followed by a major fish kill; the most severe mortality was along roughly 6 km of shoreline south of Great Point Clear.
Exceptionally valuable event because May measured DO during the Jubilee in 1.5 m water.

evidence.claimed_event_time: same day; exact capture time not stated in article text
evidence.first_person_vs_repost: viewer-submitted source media published by local TV

candidates.admission_note: Strong same-day date/location evidence and appears distinct from Jul 17 and Jul 24. Verify capture date is not recycled before canonical admission; do not archive copyrighted video.

near_miss_candidates.evidence: May measured bottom DO about 0.8 ppm to within 30 m of shoreline; from shoreline to 30 m offshore DO remained about 1.5 ppm and no Jubilee occurred.
near_miss_candidates.scientific_value: Directly separates offshore hypoxic-water availability from final nearshore contact threshold; candidate control for the latent-state architecture.
